label: Skilled’s trigger index matches prompt text against author-declared trigger_phrases, while the ripgrep lane scans literal text and returns evidence for caller-side judgment. Neither provides semantic ranking. sweet-search adds hybrid semantic, lexical and structural code search with ranked code blocks, so it covers a code-discovery gap without replacing exact identifier search or the curated documentation lookup.

The AGENTS.md decision tree sends exact symbols and known paths to literal search, then asks agents exploring unfamiliar code to search likely vocabulary, map paths and read to confirm. sweet-search search, trace and repo-map can combine those code-navigation steps and add caller/callee impact context, while the existing document retrieval path remains the relevant surface for spec and skill text.

Code Mode/UTCP is a possible delivery surface rather than another retrieval index: its manual_call_templates entries describe MCP server commands and are discoverable only when configured there, while native MCP servers are separate. An optional sweet-search manual could reuse this route, but it would still require the project to configure the server and runtime.

The current doctor routes separate Skilled setup from Code Mode MCP setup: /doctor:install is a read-only guide, while /doctor:mcp install is scoped to Code Mode build output, .utcp_config.json and runtime MCP configs. This creates a possible place to document an optional sweet-search manual, but the inspected install contract does not define a sweet-search-specific install, health or removal lifecycle.
